html: So, I've never visited this page before. I know this is going to seem odd....or maybe not? I ended up here because I have had some visions, for lack of a better term, as well as some galactic communications. In one of my last galactic communications, we spoke about "The Great Awakening of 2075". I googled that term today just for shits and giggles and this is where it landed me. This story seems to be somewhat accurate. I just wanted to touch bases with the creators to see if it was just a collaboration of "imaginations" that wrote this?
